description: Inspect one js-top task origin in depth: schedules vs runs, avg/max/total exclusive ms, a 5s activity sparkline, freeze attribution, and the captured scheduling site (caller function + stack frames). Pass a row `key` from get_js_thread_top's JSON (e.g. "interval|pollFeed" or "unattributed" for the system row).

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

key.description: Origin key from get_js_thread_top's JSON rows.

name: get_js_thread_origin_detail
